DetachStmt.doc: Parsed DETACH statement. schema_name is the OWNED logical alias whose binding the executor will release. The parser rejects 'main' and 'temp' (case-insensitive) but does NOT verify the binding exists nor check for open cursors / transactions — those are executor-side checks.

DetachParseOk.doc: Successful parse: the DETACH AST plus the index of the next unread token.

parse_detach.doc: Parse a DETACH statement starting at tokens[start]. Consumes the DETACH keyword, optional DATABASE keyword, the schema-name identifier (rejecting reserved 'main' and 'temp' case-insensitively, and rejecting non-Ident tokens). Stops BEFORE the statement terminator. Tokenizer-only dependency; no Expr embedded.
